user.title: Create Light Wrapper
user.description: Combines several lights into one light entity. Optional defaults are used when the light is turned on without brightness or color.

data_description.default_brightness_pct: Used when the light is turned on without a brightness.
data_description.default_color_temp_kelvin: Used when the light is turned on without a color; only sent to lights that support color temperature.
data_description.apply_defaults_when_on: Turning on without parameters also applies the defaults when the group is already on.

error.no_entities: Please select at least one light.
